description:
City of Cambridge, Massachusetts open data portal on Socrata, carrying 447
datasets across budget, housing, energy disclosure, inspections and
participatory budgeting, with a full SODA API and discovery catalogue.
license: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL)
name: Cambridge Open Data
notes:
Verified 2026-09-10 in the FCI Regime 1 harvest (wave 7, United States).
resultSetSize 447 via the Socrata Discovery API.

THE CATALOGUE IS ENUMERABLE, WHICH BOSTON'S IS NOT. Boston's CKAN Action
API is disallowed by its own robots.txt, so wave 1 had to count datasets
from rendered HTML. Cambridge answers the Discovery API directly. For a
federated index this is the difference between a source you can monitor and
one you have to scrape.

LICENCE IS NOT UNIFORM. PDDL is the portal default and holds on the budget,
housing and inspections datasets checked. It does NOT hold everywhere:
the BEUDO building energy and emissions datasets, the community greenhouse
gas inventory and Housing Median Sales Prices all returned "not specified".
Per-dataset licence must be re-confirmed before use; do not inherit from
this entry.

Query gotcha for anyone reusing the Discovery API: multi-word q values are
AND-matched, so q=unemployment+income+housing returns zero. Single terms
only. A zero result there is not evidence of absence.

description:
Linz publishes its open data as a publishing body on data.gv.at, Austria's
national open government data portal, rather than on a portal of its own:
823 datasets covering mobility, statistics, planning, tourism and procurement.
name: data.gv.at - Stadt Linz
notes:
Verified 2026-09-10 in the FCI Regime 1 harvest (wave 8). data.linz.gv.at
resolves to the data.gv.at catalogue pre-filtered to "Veroeffentlichende
Stelle: Stadt Linz", which reported 823 datasets that day. The portal as a
whole reported 73437 datasets, 835 applications and 2400 publishing bodies.

NO WORKING MACHINE-READABLE CATALOGUE ENDPOINT WAS FOUND. The historic CKAN
path /katalog/api/3/action/package_search now 404s, as does the locale-prefixed
variant and individual /katalog/dataset/{slug} URLs still being returned by
search engines. The portal has moved to the "data.cockpit" platform and the
querystring filters on /suche/ were ignored in testing. This is a regression
for federation: Austria's national catalogue is currently browsable but not
reliably harvestable by the route most clients expect. Flagged for a revisit
rather than guessed at - no endpoint has been recorded here by analogy.

Licence is the Cooperation OGD Oesterreich standard CC BY 4.0, in force since
2019-03-01 (before that CC BY 3.0 AT), read from data.gv.at's own Cooperation
OGD Austria page on 2026-09-10. Individual datasets may still carry the older
licence or a non-standard one; check per dataset.

Formats on the Linz records are mixed and honest about it - CSV and GeoJSON on
the sensor and mobility series (Radverkehrszaehlstellen Linz, hourly counts
2024-2025), but PDF for statistical tables such as the tourism origin series,
and a literal "UNKNOWN" format on several. Procurement notices for Linz appear
under the city's own companies (e.g. Seniorenzentren Linz GmbH) as separate
publishing bodies, so a complete Linz procurement view is a union of
publishers, not one.

Admin chain: Linz GKZ 40101, Statutarstadt and its own politischer Bezirk
(401), Land Oberoesterreich AT-4 / NUTS AT31, Austria AT.

description:
Rennes and Rennes Metropole's open-data portal (OpenDataSoft), roughly 600
datasets, ODbL-dominant. One of the oldest French municipal open-data
programmes and the source of the city's 2008-onward open budget series.
name: Open Data Rennes Metropole
notes:
Verified 2026-09-09 in the FCI Regime 1 harvest (wave 2, France) via the
OpenDataSoft v2.1 catalogue and facets endpoints.

LICENCE REGIME IS OPEN BUT NOT CLEAN, and the mess is a federation problem.
The licence facet returns TEN distinct values for what are really three
licences: ODbL 295, "Licence ODbL 1.0" 259, the same string with a newline and
a URL glued on 17, Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) 10, CC BY-ND 5, Licence
Ouverte (Etalab) 4, "Licence Ouverte" plus etalab URL 4, Open License v1.0 2,
Open License v2.0 2, and one dataset whose licence field is literally
https://www.insee.fr/fr/information/2381861. Free-text licence fields with
embedded newlines and URLs cannot be machine-reconciled across cities; any Fab
City index aggregating licence status needs a normalisation layer, and Rennes
is the proof.

NOT ALL OF IT IS OPEN: 5 datasets are CC BY-ND, which fails this repo's
criterion 1 - no derivatives means no derived indicator. At least one dataset
returns license: null (part-des-vehicules-a-faibles-et-tres-faibles-emissions-
entres-dans-le-parc-20200). So "Rennes is open data" is true in aggregate and
false per-dataset.

Theme facet verbatim: Economie 143, Mobilite Transport 111, Urbanisme 90,
Citoyennete 88, Referentiels geographiques 60, Environnement 47, Espace public
39, Culture Sports Loisirs 21, Reseaux Energie 19, Sante Securite 16,
Education 11, Enfance 2, Logement 2, Social 1.

FCI CELLS: Economic city unusually strong (143, largest theme, holds the budget
series). Environmental city served by Environnement 47 + Reseaux Energie 19.
SOCIAL CITY IS THE WEAK CELL - Social 1, Logement 2, Enfance 2, Education 11:
almost nothing on unemployment, inequality, housing affordability or life
expectancy. A real gap, not a search failure.

Admin ids: Ville de Rennes INSEE 35238, Rennes Metropole SIREN 243500139,
dept Ille-et-Vilaine 35, region Bretagne 53.

description:
City of Somerville, Massachusetts open data portal on Socrata: a small,
52-dataset catalogue licensed ODbL, notable for participatory budgeting and
the long-running municipal wellbeing survey.
license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL)
name: Somerville Open Data
notes:
Verified 2026-09-10 in the FCI Regime 1 harvest (wave 7, United States).
resultSetSize 52 via the Socrata Discovery API.

SMALL BUT LICENSED, which puts it ahead of three larger wave-7 portals.
Oakland publishes 739 datasets with no licence on anything checked; Detroit
and Sacramento publish empty licence fields across their whole catalogues.
Somerville publishes 52 and states ODbL. On CONTRIBUTING criterion 1, 52
beats 739.

ODbL, NOT PDDL - the opposite of its Massachusetts neighbours Boston and
Cambridge. ODbL carries share-alike and attribution obligations that public
domain dedication does not. Any derived FCI product mixing Somerville with
Boston or Cambridge data inherits the stricter terms. This is a real
licensing hazard inside a single metro area, not a footnote.

No operating budget on the portal. The capital plan is here but frozen since
2016 - see economic/city/somerville-capital-investment-plan.

description:
Toulouse Metropole's open-data portal (OpenDataSoft), 835 datasets and entirely
openly licensed. The largest municipal catalogue found in the French wave, with
a 218-dataset finance theme and a dedicated circular-economy theme.
name: Open Data Toulouse Metropole
notes:
Verified 2026-09-09 in the FCI Regime 1 harvest (wave 2, France) via the
OpenDataSoft v2.1 catalogue and facets endpoints.

835 datasets, 100% openly licensed. Licence facet verbatim: Licence Ouverte
v2.0 (Etalab) 667, Open Database License (ODbL) 164, Licence Ouverte (Etalab) 2,
Open License v1.0 1, Open License v2.0 1. No unstated, no restricted, no ND.
Largest AND cleanest municipal catalogue in this wave.

Theme facet, verbatim with counts: Finance 218, Environnement 174, Citoyennete
170, Statistiques 77, Transport 61, Territoire 37, Culture 35, Economie 30,
Amenagement 22, Services 21, Sport 21, Enfance 20, Patrimoine 17, "Dechets et
economie circulaire" 3, Tourisme 2.

TWO THINGS THAT SET IT APART:
1. Finance is the LARGEST theme (218 of 835). A city whose biggest open-data
   category is its own money is a different governance posture from one whose
   biggest category is bus timetables. Compare Paris, where finance is 65 of 476.
2. It carries an explicit "Dechets et economie circulaire" theme. Only 3
   datasets, so treat it as a signal of intent rather than a data supply - but
   it is the only French portal in this wave that names circular economy as a
   category at all, which matters for the Fab City framing.

FCI CELL MAPPING: Economic city and Governance city are both strong (Finance
218, Economie 30, Citoyennete 170). Environmental city is strong (174).
Social city is thin and scattered - Statistiques 77 may carry INSEE-derived
social indicators but was not opened in this pass; Enfance 20 and Services 21
are service inventories, not social outcomes. Region-scale cells are not served
here: the region rung is Occitanie (76), a separate publisher.

Admin identifiers: Ville de Toulouse INSEE 31555, Toulouse Metropole SIREN
243100518 (published as "Grand Toulouse" before 2015 - the same body under its
old name, so pre-2015 datasets use that label), departement Haute-Garonne 31,
region Occitanie 76.

description:
City of Zagreb open data portal, CKAN-based. 199 datasets covering city
budget, local self-government funding, transport, utilities, kindergartens,
air quality geodata and council composition.
name: Portal otvorenih podataka Grada Zagreba
notes:
Verified 2026-09-11 in the FCI Regime 1 harvest (wave 10, Croatia +
Netherlands). Dataset count 199 read from the rendered catalogue at
/dataset on 2026-09-11.

THE API FIELD IS NULL BY ROBOTS, NOT BY ABSENCE. The portal is CKAN and the
footer advertises "Takoder mozete pristupiti registru koristeci API (vidi
API Docs)". But data.zagreb.hr/robots.txt disallows /api/, so
/api/3/action/* is not available to a well-behaved client. Catalogue
enumeration here came from rendered HTML. Same treatment as Analyze Boston.

LICENCE is portal-wide "Otvorena dozvola (OD)", the Croatian national open
licence at http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola, shown on every dataset page
checked. It is not an SPDX identifier; it is an attribution licence.

This entry is the CATALOGUE ITSELF - a Governance|City indicator in its own
right (dataset count plus licence regime). Specific Zagreb datasets are
separate entries: economic/city/zagreb-proracun and
economic/city/zagreb-sredstva-mjesne-samouprave.

Zagreb is simultaneously a city and a county (zupanija) under Croatian law,
so this portal is the city AND the regional rung for the Zagreb territory.
Grad Zagreb does not appear as an organisation on the national portal
data.gov.hr - it publishes here instead.

description:
Chile's national open data portal, CKAN 2.10.4, publishing 3,211 datasets
from 272 institutions including central government and many municipalities.
Used as the Santiago pilot's open-data substrate.
name: datos.gob.cl
notes:
Re-verified 2026-09-09 in the FCI Regime 1 harvest (wave 1). Two corrections,
one of which matters a lot:

1. THE LICENCE CLAIM WAS UNSUPPORTED. This entry previously read "public
   domain (Chilean government)". No such statement was found. The portal's
   licence regime could not be established at all, because
   /api/3/action/package_search is disallowed by the site's own robots.txt,
   so per-dataset licence fields cannot be enumerated programmatically and
   the homepage does not state a blanket licence. Recorded as "not stated",
   which is honest and which means CONTRIBUTING criterion 1 is NOT satisfied
   for anything pulled from here until a licence is confirmed per dataset.
2. API set to null for the same robots.txt reason.

Counts (3,211 datasets, 272 institutions, 9,615 registered users) are from
the homepage's own figures, not from the API.

SCALE IS ARGUABLE AND LEFT AS-IS. This is a national portal filed at city
scale because that is how the Santiago pilot uses it. Moving it to region or
planet would change its slug and break the Airtable sync key, so the
inconsistency is recorded here rather than fixed silently.

CHILE IS DATA-RICH AND LICENCE-POOR. Wave 1 produced ZERO YAML-eligible
sources for Santiago. SINIM (datos.sinim.gov.cl), the only comuna-level
municipal finance source in the country, claims "Creative Commons Atribucion
2.0 Chile" in its footer while its terms restrict use to "fines que estime
pertinentes, sin fines comerciales" - a non-commercial clause inside a CC-BY
claim. SINCA (sinca.mma.gob.cl), the only PM2.5 source for Santiago, is
"Todos los derechos reservados". Both are recorded as restricted-licence
candidates in the coverage tracker, deliberately without YAML files.

description:
Montreal's CKAN 2.11.5 open data catalogue - 404 datasets, 394 under
CC BY 4.0 and 284 carrying a CSV. Hosts non-municipal publishers
alongside the city. Catalogue breadth and licence openness are
themselves governance indicators.
name: Donnees ouvertes - Ville de Montreal
notes:
Added 2026-09-11 in the FCI Regime 1 harvest (wave 13, Montreal). This
entry is THE CATALOGUE ITSELF, a legitimate Governance|City indicator:
dataset count and licence regime are the open-data-availability signal.

NUMBERS from the portal's own facet counts. 404 datasets. Licences: CC
BY 4.0 - 394; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 - 8; OGL Canada - 2. A 97.5% fully-open
share, among the highest in the harvest. Formats: CSV 284, GeoJSON 121,
SHP 118, WEB 55, PDF 47 - ~70% carry a CSV. Publishers: Ville de
Montreal 389, STM 7, Agence de mobilite durable 3, Bixi 2, Coalition
des Eco-quartiers 2. Non-municipal publishers are hosted here, which
matters for attribution.

READ THE 97.5% WITH THIS: eight datasets are CC BY-NC-SA and WHICH
EIGHT WAS NOT ESTABLISHED. Read license_id per dataset from the API;
never rely on the portal default for a specific source.

API URL IS ASSERTED FROM THE VERIFIED CKAN VERSION STRING (2.11.5), NOT
FETCHED. robots.txt carries Disallow: /api/ with Crawl-Delay: 10, so
the counts above come from rendered HTML. Faceted search URLs (?tags=,
?res_format=, ?organization=, ?license_id=) are also disallowed; plain
?q= and canonical dataset pages are allowed. Same situation as
analyze-boston, same deliberate choice: ignoring robots is a decision,
not a default.

THE ARRONDISSEMENT BUDGET RUNG IS A VERIFIED DELIBERATE NEGATIVE. A
full budget-scoped catalogue query (14 results, all enumerated) found
exactly ONE arrondissement budget dataset across 19 arrondissements -
Rosemont-La Petite-Patrie, flagged Archive, 2015. Montreal does not
fail at open data; it does not publish sub-municipal budgets as data.
Meanwhile Quebec province publishes every municipality's full financial
return as CSV/XLSX. In Quebec the community budget rung is served from
above, not below.

description:
The cities, regions and countries that have pledged to produce most of what they
consume by 2054, with the year each one signed. The Fab City commitment as a
list rather than a map on a website.
license: No licence published — the repository carries none. The Foundation's own list, and the one source here it could license with a sentence.
name: Fab City pledged cities
notes:
READ IN FULL 2026-09-20 from data/fabcity.xlsx in the public Fab Foundation
repository at gitlab.fabcloud.org/fl-management/fablab-network-data. 61 rows,
six columns: name, slug, country_code, level, pledge, city.

  level    48 City, 11 Region, 2 Country
  pledge   signature years 2014-2026
  spread   27 countries
  example  Bali, fc-bali, ID, Region, 2022, Denpasar

WHY IT IS AN ACT SOURCE AND `act_kind: network`. It names no machine and hosts
no design. It is a set of places bound by a commitment rather than by
capability — which is exactly what `network` is for, and what distinguishes it
from the fab lab directory filed at economic/community/fablabs-io. A node can
answer "is this place pledged, and since when" from it, which is a governance
question, hence the pillar.

FORMAT: .xlsx, not JSON or CSV. Reachable programmatically through the GitLab
raw-file API (the `api` field above, verified 200, 13,808 bytes), but a reader
must parse a spreadsheet. Six columns of flat text in one sheet, so the parse
is trivial — but it is a spreadsheet, and anything depending on it should say
so out loud rather than discover it.

THIS IS THE FOUNDATION'S OWN DATA, AND THE EASIEST LICENCE ON THIS LIST TO FIX.
Every other licence gap here needs somebody else to answer: fablabs.io needs a
scoped statement, Open Know-How needs a version number, Field Ready needs to
reconcile its site with its catalogue. This one needs a single sentence from the
people who compiled it. CC-BY-4.0 GeoJSON on fab.city would make it the
network's first unambiguously open act source; it has coordinates implied by
`city` and nothing sensitive in it.

No `adapter`: nothing in planetai-node reads it yet.

description:
Sweden's municipal KPI database - roughly 6000 indicators across
finance, schools, care, environment and governance for every kommun
and region, with an open JSON API. Lund is municipality_id 1281.
license: Free of charge, no agreement required, commercial use permitted; attribution "Kalla, Kolada" required unless the data has been substantially processed
name: Kolada v3 - Swedish municipal and regional KPI database
notes:
Added 2026-09-11 in the FCI Regime 1 harvest (wave 13, Veberod/Lund).

VERIFIED BY DIRECT CALL:
https://api.kolada.se/v3/data?kpi_id=N07402&municipality_id=1281&year=2024
returns a value for municipality 1281. A companion call
/v3/municipality?title=Lund returns {"id":"1281","title":"Lund"} and
?title=Malm returns {"id":"1280","title":"Malmo"} - which is how
Lund=1281 was confirmed rather than assumed.

TWO BREAKING CHANGES THAT WILL SILENTLY KILL OLD CODE. (1) v2 IS GONE:
api.kolada.se/v2/* returns HTTP 410 Gone. Every tutorial, every
GitHub client and every older note pointing at v2 is dead. v3 base is
https://api.kolada.se/v3, docs at /v3/docs, released 2025-04-04.
(2) PARAMETER NAMES CHANGED: v2's ?kpi=&municipality= now returns
HTTP 422. You must use ?kpi_id= and ?municipality_id=. A 422 with no
readable message is the failure mode anyone porting old code will hit.

KPI ids are N or U plus five digits; unit-level ids use V prefixes
(V11 preschools, V15 grundskola). Publication is continuous through
the year, and Kolada states data may be revised without notice and
individual KPIs may be removed - so do not treat a Kolada value as
immutable or cache it as final.

Pillar is governance, not economic: this is municipal benchmarking
infrastructure, an indicator layer over many domains, not a budget.
The Swedish budget amounts live in
economic/city/scb-kommun-kostnader-verksamhetsomrade.

Licence is NOT a named standard licence. It is a custom permission
grant: free of charge, no agreement, commercial use explicitly
allowed, attribution required unless substantially processed. Judged
open and CC-BY-equivalent in substance; the terms are recorded in the
license field rather than an SPDX id so a reviewer sees them.

description:
Ljubljana's municipal open data portal on ArcGIS Hub - geospatial
layers for roads, cycle paths, parking, sports, schools, health
network and heritage, downloadable as CSV, GeoJSON and KML.
name: Odprti podatki Mestne obcine Ljubljana (ArcGIS Hub)
notes:
Added 2026-09-11 in the FCI Regime 1 harvest (wave 13, Ljubljana).
This entry is the catalogue itself, the Governance|City open-data
availability indicator.

WHAT THE CATALOGUE ACTUALLY CONTAINS IS THE FINDING, AND IT IS A
NEGATIVE ONE. MOL's eight nationally-catalogued datasets are
ENTIRELY PHYSICAL AND FACILITY LAYERS - municipal roads, cultural
heritage, educational institutions, car parks, cycle paths, LPP bus
stops, sports facilities, health network. No financial indicator, no
social indicator, no economic indicator, no waste or emissions data.
Ljubljana's open data estate is a facilities map. For a European
Green Capital, the absence of waste and recycling data is the
conspicuous gap.

DATASET COUNT NOT OBTAINED - the Hub site renders client-side.

THE BIGGEST TRAP IN THIS LOCALITY. The generic ArcGIS Hub API works:
https://hub.arcgis.com/api/v3/datasets?q=Ljubljana returned valid JSON
with totalCount 532. BUT THOSE 532 ARE GLOBAL ITEMS MATCHING THE
STRING "Ljubljana", owned by unrelated accounts - a Dutch
municipality, a US high school, private users - all with license
"none". A connector that queries Hub by keyword will SILENTLY INGEST
OTHER PEOPLE'S MAPS and attribute them to Ljubljana. The correct
approach is to filter by MOL's ArcGIS orgId, WHICH WAS NOT OBTAINED.
api is recorded as null rather than pointing at an endpoint that
returns the wrong city's data. Recover the orgId from the Hub site's
bootstrap JSON or /api/v3/sites before wiring anything.

LICENCE IS ONE STEP OF INFERENCE, FLAGGED. "Priznanje avtorstva (CC BY
4.0)" was verified on the eight MOL datasets mirrored to the national
OPSI portal, NOT on the Hub site, which states no terms of use at all.
The OPSI application record for the Hub
(podatki.gov.si/aplikacije/odprti-podatki-mestne-obcine-ljubljana,
published 2022-10-04) confirms the URL but also states no licence.

description:
Wuppertal's municipal open data portal, run on DKAN and hosted for the city by
Stadt Koeln. Around 290 datasets across geodata, population, budget, mobility,
environment and elections for the largest city of the Bergisches Staedtedreieck.
name: Offene Daten Wuppertal
notes:
Verified 2026-09-10 in the FCI Regime 1 harvest (wave 8) by calling
package_list and package_show. The portal is DKAN, not CKAN: package_list and
package_show work at /api/3/action/, but package_search does not and returns
the site's HTML 404. Anything written against a CKAN client needs that
exception.

Category counts read from the portal on 2026-09-10: Geo 88, Infrastruktur
Bauen und Wohnen 49, Transport und Verkehr 32, Umwelt und Klima 28,
Verwaltung Haushalt und Steuern 19, Kultur Freizeit Sport 19, Gesetze und
Justiz 13, Bildung und Wissenschaft 11, Bevoelkerung 8, Politik und Wahlen 8,
Gesundheit 7, Wirtschaft und Arbeit 4, Soziales 3, Verbraucherschutz 3.

BUDGET SERIES ENDS IN 2017. The only budget datasets are haushaltsplan-20122013,
haushaltsplan-20142015 and haushaltsplan-20162017. package_show on the last of
these returned license_id cc-by/4.0 and resources that are zipped volumes of
the NKF three-component plan (Gesamtergebnisplan, Gesamtfinanzplan). Useful as
a structural reference for North Rhine-Westphalian NKF accounting; not a
current fiscal signal. For current Wuppertal finance use the Regionaldatenbank
at AGS 05124000.

Also present and directly useful to FCI social and economic cells:
ein-und-auspendlerinnen-nach-bzw-aus-wuppertal (commuting flows),
sozialversicherungspflichtig-beschaeftigte-am-wohnort-wuppertal-nach-
altersgruppen (employment), gebaeude-und-wohnungsbestand-wuppertal-am-
jahresende (housing stock), and the Kommunalwahlbezirke / Stimmbezirke
electoral geographies.

Solingen and Remscheid, the other two cities of the Bergisches
Staedtedreieck, have no equivalent portal of their own that this harvest
found. "Bergisches" federates only as the union of three AGS codes.

description:
Queryable ArcGIS FeatureServers for UK statistical geography, serving
vintaged GSS codes and boundaries from output area to country. Around
600 vintage-suffixed services, no key, no authentication.
name: ONS Open Geography Portal - ArcGIS REST services
notes:
Added 2026-09-11 in the FCI Regime 1 harvest (wave 13, Plymouth).
THE CLEANEST ADMIN-CODE SPINE IN THE ENTIRE HARVEST. Why:

(1) MACHINE-READABLE AND QUERYABLE, not a PDF annex. One
unauthenticated call - FeatureServer/0/query filtered on LAD24NM -
returned one feature, LAD24CD E06000026. Verified, not asserted.
(2) VINTAGED, NOT SILENTLY MUTATED. The layer carries its vintage
(Local_Authority_Districts_December_2024) and so do its fields
(LAD24CD, not a bare CODE). When boundaries change ONS issues a NEW
code and a NEW layer rather than editing in place, so historic data
stays joinable. 600+ vintage-suffixed services in the directory.
(3) CODED ALL THE WAY DOWN BELOW THE CITY - OA, LSOA, MSOA, ward and
LAD share one namespace, so sub-city aggregation is a code join, not a
name match.

That third property is what most localities here lack, and it makes an
LSOA-level Fab City indicator TECHNICALLY POSSIBLE in the UK even where

description:
Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes' statutory public-procurement award register, published continuously
as one small JSON record per notified contract following the Etalab commande-publique
schema.
name: Région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes — données essentielles de la commande publique
notes:
Verified 2026-09-09: organisation API and the -1956 dataset page opened, HTTP 200, most
recent record timestamped the same day. Openly licensed (fr-lo / Licence Ouverte),
JSON, schema at github.com/etalab/format-commande-publique, statutory basis the décret of
14 April 2017 as amended 27 July 2018.
THE FINDING IS THE SHAPE, NOT THE EXISTENCE. 1,957 of this organisation's 1,973 data.gouv.fr
datasets are procurement award notices — 99.2%. Each is a separate dataset record carrying a
single ~1.2 KB JSON file. So the three questions this list keeps separate give three
different answers here: data exists YES; openly licensed YES; machine-readable per file yes,
but as a REGISTER no — reconstructing the award series means ~1,957 catalogue calls and a
merge, with no bulk export offered. Anyone wiring this needs to budget for that.
Cadence is effectively continuous: multiple new records per working day.
THE CONTRAST WORTH KEEPING: Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes publishes procurement and no budget
(a "budget" query against the organisation returns 0). Neighbouring Occitanie publishes
budgets and comptes administratifs and no procurement register (a "marchés publics" query
returns 0). Two adjacent French regions, each publishing precisely what the other withholds.
Neither is a transparency failure on its own; together they are the argument for federating
rather than surveying.
NOT CHECKED: whether award value, CPV code and titulaire SIRET are populated per record,
which is what decides whether local-sourcing share is computable. Open the schema against
live records before anyone builds on it.

431 resources, most recent September 2026 - live.

TRAPS. (1) THIS IS AN APPEND-ONLY FEED, NOT A TABLE. 431 weekly and
monthly files; a connector must enumerate resources via the API and
accumulate. (2) TWO FORMATS COVERING DIFFERENT ERAS WITH DIFFERENT
SCHEMAS - XML from 2009, JSON from March 2021. A full history requires
implementing both parsers. Two specification documents are published
as resources; the XML spec is mandatory reading. (3) Contract amount
and supplier field names were NOT confirmed - the page describes
record types, not fields.

Licence is the portal default (CC-BY 4.0 Quebec), not stated on the
dataset page. Same inference as the MAMH entries.

description:
Every Dutch public procurement notice - market consultations, contract
notices, awards, modifications and early terminations - published by PIANOo
via TenderNed, downloadable in bulk and available as feeds and a webservice.
name: TenderNed - Aankondigingen van overheidsopdrachten
notes:
Verified 2026-09-11 in the FCI Regime 1 harvest (wave 10). Licence CC-0
(1.0), read from the national register record; publisher PIANOo (Rijk).

BULK FILES, opened at tenderned.nl/cms/nl/aanbesteden-in-cijfers/datasets-
aanbestedingen: Excel covering 2021 through 2026 Q2 (66.68 MB), 2016-2020
(52.24 MB) and 2010-2015 (17.32 MB); JSON one file per year 2016-2026,
55-110 MB each. Consolidated files refresh roughly twice a year; the live
feeds are continuous.

THE OPEN ROUTE AND THE KEYED ROUTE ARE DIFFERENT. Bulk downloads, the RSS
feed and the TNS publication webservice need no credentials. The XML API
does - TenderNed issues a username and password on request to
functioneelbeheer@tenderned.nl. Build on the open route.

WHY GOVERNANCE, NOT ECONOMIC: this list treats procurement as governance -
the signal is what the public sector chooses to buy. For a Fab City reading
it is the most direct available measure of whether local production is

THE UNTESTED THING HERE IS THE MOST INTERESTING ITEM IN THE UK PASS:
the PAYMENTS TRANSPARENCY REGISTER. Under the Procurement Act 2023
contracting authorities must publish payment information to this
national register. If it carries local authority payments it replaces
the whole messy Plymouth spend-over-500 situation - stale 2015 CSVs on
one portal, current unlicensed XLSX on another - with one national,
structured, openly-licensed feed. TEST THIS FIRST next UK touch. It is
the difference between a per-city scraper and one national connector.

TWO REGISTERS, OVERLAPPING AND TIME-SPLIT. Contracts Finder covers the
pre-February-2025 regime and lower-value notices; Find a Tender covers

history needs BOTH, deduplicated on ocid, with the regime boundary at

documentation page states no licence at all - see the tracker Notes.

description:
The Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology's catalogue of

name: Glottolog
notes:
Verified 2026-09-09. Version 5.3 current. Formats: PostgreSQL dumps, CSV
(including a CSV of geographic coordinates for languages and dialects),
BibTeX, RDF, and Newick trees for language families. Curated on GitHub

intersect the coordinate CSV with a bioregion polygon to count languoids
present and, where endangerment status is populated, their vitality.
This is the only openly licensed way found to attach any culturally
specific measure to a bioregion polygon. INTERPRETATION LIMIT: it
measures languages present, not knowledge held or transmitted. Use it as
a contextual layer for traditional knowledge, never as a measure of
knowledge preservation. Also note each version is a snapshot of
scholarly consensus, so year-over-year change reflects catalogue
revision as much as real change - it is not a time series.

polygons: intersect the bioregion boundary with the community-lands
layer and compute area held or acknowledged. CRITICAL READING CAVEAT:
coverage is about 30% of global land area against an estimated 50%+
actually held by Indigenous Peoples and communities. A bioregion scoring
low may simply be unmapped. Absence of mapped land is not evidence of
absence of land rights and the index must say so.

formations professionnelles" tracks which technical and vocational courses a region opens
and closes over time. That is the closest openly published proxy for whether a territory is
building or losing the skills base that distributed manufacturing depends on. Most regions
publish a school list; publishing the CHANGE in vocational provision is less common and more
useful.
Upper-secondary education is a French regional competence, which is why these sit at region
scale rather than city.
The fifth dataset, consultation-lycee-de-demain, is a participation record rather than a
social indicator — it belongs to the governance cell and is noted in the FCI tracker there
rather than filed separately.
NOT VERIFIED: per-school enrolment or outcome fields. This is provision and location data,
not attainment data; it answers "what is offered where", not "who completes it".
